headline: Friday Heat Dome: PumpkinFest Opens, AC Shows Win the Afternoon
lede: Friday, September 18th keeps Branson in the upper 90s — Open-Meteo calls for about 98°F under mostly cloudy skies, a low near 76°F, and almost no rain chance. First-timers: take the lake or a quiet breakfast early, hide in air-conditioned theaters and museums through peak heat, then ease into Shepherd of the Hills PumpkinFest energy and a Big D's BBQ dinner as the Strip cools after dusk.

featured.title: Shepherd of the Hills PumpkinFest Opens
featured.when: Friday through the weekend (main run starts today)
featured.where: Shepherd of the Hills Adventure Park · W 76 Country Blvd
featured.why: Strip scout flagged Friday as the main PumpkinFest kickoff — pumpkin fun, family grounds energy, and the Copperhead Mountain Coaster if you want a cooler ride in the trees. Perfect heat-day counterweight to a long afternoon outdoors: go late day, confirm hours and tickets on-site.

plan.title: Cool water before the dome builds
plan.detail: Table Rock and Taneycomo are most comfortable before 10 AM. Drift or cruise early; call SWPA 866-494-1993 for generation before wading Taneycomo. Low-clear Table Rock means watch stumps in the coves.

plan.title: Air-conditioned matinee or museum block
plan.detail: Skip the 2–5 PM heat on the pavement. WonderWorks, Titanic Museum, or a matinee theater keep families cool. Confirm box office for Friday showtimes — Thursday listings do not automatically carry.

plan.title: PumpkinFest glow + Big D's BBQ
plan.detail: As temps ease, head toward Shepherd of the Hills for opening-weekend fall vibes, then plate up at Big D's BBQ (Friday restaurant spotlight) — casual ribs, easy drive from Notch Lane, no lakeside wait required.

indoor.name: WonderWorks Branson
indoor.detail: Upside-down building, 100+ STEAM exhibits, full AC — ideal Friday heat shelter on the 76 Strip.

indoor.name: Sight & Sound Theatres
indoor.detail: Large-scale biblical stage productions in a cooled house. Book ahead; confirm Friday performance time at the box office.

indoor.name: Titanic Museum Attraction
indoor.detail: Walk-through galleries and AC corridors when the Strip is too hot to stroll. Verify Friday hours locally.
